info.title: Perplexity Router API (OpenAI-compatible)
info.description: OpenAI Chat Completions-compatible access to models across providers, plus the model catalog. Schema structure follows the OpenAI Chat Completions wire format (derived from the MIT-licensed OpenAI OpenAPI specification); all documentation text is Perplexity's own.

post.description: Send a conversation to any Router model using the OpenAI Chat Completions schema. Set `stream: true` to receive server-sent events; add `stream_options: {"include_usage": true}` to get token usage in the final chunk.

200.description: Successful response. JSON for non-streaming requests; a `text/event-stream` of chat completion chunks terminated by `data: [DONE]` when `stream` is true.

400.description: Invalid request — malformed body, unsupported parameter, or a model that is not available on the Router.

429.description: Rate limit exceeded or the upstream model is overloaded. Retry after the `Retry-After` interval.

get.description: List the models available through the Router, sorted by id. Each model includes its base token prices in `pricing` (USD per 1M tokens).

200.description: The list of available models with base token prices.

get.description: Retrieve one model by id, including its base token prices. Model ids contain a `/` (for example `perplexity/kimi-k3`); pass the full id in the path.

404.description: No model with this id is available on the Router.

include_usage.description: When `true`, a final chunk before `data: [DONE]` reports token usage for the whole request.

prompt_tokens.description: Input tokens for the request, including cache reads and writes.

messages.description: The conversation so far, as an array of message objects with `role` and `content`. The leading `system` or `developer` message is applied as the system prompt.

model.description: The model that will process the request, as a `creator/model-name` id from the catalog — for example `perplexity/kimi-k3`. Any cataloged model works with this endpoint.

reasoning_effort.description: How much reasoning the model performs before answering, on models that support it. When omitted, the provider's default for that model applies; defaults vary by provider and model.

max_completion_tokens.description: Upper bound on generated tokens for this request, including reasoning tokens.

response_format.description: Output format. Use type `json_schema` for strict structured output or `json_object` for JSON mode.

stream.description: When `true`, tokens are sent as server-sent events as they are generated, terminated by `data: [DONE]`.

stop.description: Up to 4 sequences at which generation stops.

stream_options.description: Streaming options. Only allowed when `stream` is `true`.

tools.description: Function tools the model may call. Every tool requires a `description`.

tool_choice.description: Controls whether the model may call tools, requires a specific tool, or limits selection with `allowed_tools`.

parallel_tool_calls.description: Whether the model may request more than one tool call in a single turn.

choices.description: The completion. Contains exactly one choice.

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the completion was created.

model.description: The model id you requested. Billing always uses this model's published rates.

service_tier.description: The processing tier that served the request.

id.description: Unique identifier for the completion; identical across all chunks of one response.

choices.description: Incremental output. Empty in the final usage chunk when `stream_options.include_usage` is set.

created.description: Unix timestamp of when the completion was created; identical across all chunks.

usage.description: Present only in the final chunk, and only when the request set `stream_options.include_usage`.

prompt_cache_options.description: Prompt-cache settings. Set `ttl` to `5m`, `1h`, or `24h` to control cache retention.

param.description: The request parameter the error refers to, when applicable.

ModelIdsShared.description: A `creator/model-name` id from the Router catalog.

metadata.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility; not forwarded to the model.

temperature.description: Sampling temperature, 0 to 2. Higher values produce more varied output. Adjust this or `top_p`, not both.

top_p.description: Nucleus-sampling threshold, 0 to 1. Adjust this or `temperature`, not both.

user.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility; not forwarded to the model.

safety_identifier.description: Accepted for SDK compatibility; not forwarded to the model.

prompt_cache_key.description: Stable key grouping related requests to improve prompt-cache hit rates.

service_tier.description: Processing tier for the request. `flex` halves token rates on supported models; `auto` and `default` are equivalent.

prompt_cache_retention.description: Deprecated cache-retention setting. Use `prompt_cache_options.ttl` for new integrations.

owned_by.description: Provider prefix of the slug, e.g. `perplexity`.

ModelPricing.description: Base token prices in USD per 1M tokens. Every field is a price; cache_read is the effective cached-input price.
